eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.description: Which disaster types to track. Empty = all.

minMagnitude.title: Min earthquake magnitude
minMagnitude.description: Earthquakes below this magnitude are skipped. 4 to 5 keeps it to quakes people feel; 6 and up is destructive.

minAlertLevel.title: Min alert level
minAlertLevel.description: GDACS and USGS PAGER alert severity floor. Green returns everything; orange and red only the serious events.

sinceHours.title: Earthquake window (hours)
sinceHours.description: How far back to include earthquakes. Max 720 (30 days).

includeOngoing.title: Include ongoing disasters
includeOngoing.description: Droughts, floods, and cyclones can run for weeks. On: all currently active events are included regardless of start date. Off: only events that started inside the window.

countries.title: Countries (optional)
countries.description: Only events whose location mentions one of these, e.g. Japan, Kenya, Philippines. Empty = worldwide.

maxRows.title: Max events per run
maxRows.description: Cap on event rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip events seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned events across runs and skip them. Turn on with a schedule for a live new-disasters feed.
